research_role: one full article-level event extraction after Stage 1 pass; no outcome join or trading action
selection_basis: V3.9 passed every predeclared Stage 1 reliability requirement in two independent 114-headline runs. Both runs produced 114 schema-valid records, zero evidence fallbacks, exact categorical agreement, affected-assets mean Jaccard 1.0, and zero continuous-field difference. The only change from v3.8 is removal of the cross-field requirement coupling direct btc_relevance to a BTC or Bitcoin affected-assets label; all asset canonicalization, deterministic dedupe, schema/value/evidence validation, prompt, model, sample, and thresholds remain unchanged. Regression tests replay the exact failed v3.8 batch. This config opens one new full extraction from record zero. No failed checkpoint, market outcome, predictive metric, threshold, or trading result is reused or consulted.

btc_asset_alias_policy.mode: closed exact allowlist after whitespace collapse and casefold; deterministic post-canonicalization dedupe preserving first occurrence
btc_asset_alias_policy.dedupe: preserve the first occurrence after canonicalization
btc_asset_alias_policy.direct_btc_requirement: disabled; btc_relevance and affected_assets are independently validated and model values are preserved
btc_asset_alias_policy.unlisted_values: preserve then apply the unchanged v3.5 validator

completion_gate.decision: all requirements must pass before the extraction artifact can be frozen for downstream design

prohibited: reusing any failed v3.8 checkpoint under the v3.9 contract
canonicalizing affected-assets values outside the frozen exact allowlist
changing btc_relevance or affected_assets values to manufacture cross-field consistency
joining market outcomes during full extraction
computing predictive metrics, selecting a target or horizon, or tuning a threshold
creating an action, position size, backtest, or Tech overlay
running more than one LLM worker
continuing compute at NVIDIA GPU temperature 75 C or above
